title: Verticals grid · photo-card catalog
description: Signature industry catalog. Thirteen CMS-addressable cards in a responsive photo-card grid. Each card uses the same media placeholder/photo slot, title, description, URL href, editable status label, and editable CTA label.

source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-25 — verticals grid uses Lorem ipsum photo-card catalog pattern, not small SVG glyph cards

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width industries grid background; separate from per-card media slots.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

notes: Media slots are real optional image slots. When a slot image URL is empty, the neutral striped placeholder with dimension + photo hint remains visible.
Grid renders 4 columns on wide desktop, 3 columns below 1180px, 2 below 880px, and 1 below 560px.
All visible cards share one visual and CMS parameter pattern; slot 1 is not visually special.
Card CTAs are editable label/link placeholders only; this block intentionally does not include a CMS uploader or waitlist modal.

Hover glow + halo are intentionally NOT delegated to effect.hover-rise: vertical-card's hover composes a depth shadow with the halo. The local copy stays byte-identical to the effect's canonical values; if effect.hover-rise's geometry changes, update this block too.
